seo.howToTitle: How to Convert JPG to PDF Offline
seo.howToSubtitle: Transform your images into crisp, print-ready PDF documents in three effortless steps without uploading files to any external server.

steps.title: 1. Select or Drop Your Images
steps.text: Click the 'Select JPG images' button or drag and drop one or multiple JPG, PNG, or WebP files directly into the dropzone.

steps.title: 2. Arrange, Rotate & Customize Layout
steps.text: Reorder pages via drag-and-drop or arrow buttons, rotate individual photos in 90° steps, and choose your preferred orientation (Portrait/Landscape), page size (A4, US Letter, or Fit to Image), and margins.

steps.title: 3. Instant Client-Side PDF Download
steps.text: Click 'Convert to PDF' to compile your document locally using HTML5 Canvas and jsPDF. Your PDF downloads immediately with zero waiting on cloud queues.

seo.privacyTitle: Why 100% Client-Side PDF Conversion Protects Your Privacy
seo.privacyLead: Traditional online PDF converters require you to upload sensitive personal documents, ID scans, receipts, or contracts to remote third-party servers. ToPDF eliminates that risk entirely.

privacyCards.title: Zero Server Uploads
privacyCards.text: Every image you select stays strictly inside your device's local RAM. No network requests are ever made with your files.

privacyCards.title: HTML5 Canvas & jsPDF Engine
privacyCards.text: Image rotation, scaling, margin alignment, and PDF binary assembly execute natively in your browser thread at hardware-accelerated speeds.

privacyCards.title: Installable Offline PWA
privacyCards.text: Click 'Add to Home Screen' in the navigation bar to install ToPDF as a standalone Progressive Web App that works on airplanes or without Wi-Fi.

faqs.question: Are my JPG and PNG images uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. ToPDF is 100% client-side. All image processing and PDF creation happen directly inside your web browser using JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, and jsPDF. Your files never leave your computer or phone.

faqs.question: Can I convert JPG to PDF without an internet connection?
faqs.answer: Yes! Once you load ToPDF or install it via the 'Add to Home Screen' button, our Progressive Web App (PWA) Service Worker caches the entire application so you can convert images to PDF completely offline.

faqs.question: Which image formats are supported besides JPG?
faqs.answer: In addition to standard JPG and JPEG photos, ToPDF natively supports PNG (automatically compositing transparent backgrounds onto clean white PDF pages) and WebP images.

faqs.question: Is there a file size limit or watermark on converted PDFs?
faqs.answer: There are no artificial file counts, paywalls, daily limits, or watermarks. Because your own device processes the files, you can merge dozens of high-resolution photos into a single clean PDF for free.
